node.title: DLI phase-side pole+conductor manifest (Pro, verified)
node.statement: For each DLI tuple: the Artin-Schreier reduced phase hP_lambda has a prime-to-p pole of order ed (d odd <p, e a 2-power sqrt pullback), surviving nondegeneracy, with conductor majorant ed + C_tame. Parts 1-3 of the reduced-phase manifest.
